reason: At $24.99 for the first box it works out to about 83 cents a day, and the lab report plus the money-back guarantee mean I am not risking much. One sachet I can toss in my bag is easier than the bottle I forget on the counter.
objection: Two capsules every day is still a lot to swallow, and at $29.99 full price I would just wait for the next coupon or a cheaper magnesium at the drugstore.
would_change_my_mind: If the launch price were not there and it was the full $29.99, I would probably pass and wait for a sale.
